chunks: My father (may God have mercy on him) narrated to us. He said: Ali ibn Musa ibn Ja'far ibn Abi Ja'far al-Kamandani narrated to us, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr, from al-Husayn ibn Mus'ab al-Hamadani. He said: I heard al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) say:
Fulfill trusts, even to the killer of al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon them both).

key_terms.الأمانة: Trust, a thing entrusted to someone for safekeeping; faithfulness to a trust
key_terms.قاتل الحسين: The killer of al-Husayn -- used as the most extreme example of a morally reprehensible person

ai.seo_question: What did Imam al-Sadiq say about fulfilling trusts even to the worst person?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) commands the unconditional fulfillment of trusts (amanah), using the most extreme example imaginable -- even to the killer of his own grandfather Imam al-Husayn (AS). This hadith, narrated in Shaykh al-Saduq's assembly of 21 Safar 368 AH, underscores that the obligation to return what is entrusted to one's care is absolute and is not contingent upon the moral character of the person to whom the trust belongs.

en.bilal-muhammad: My father (rh) narrated to us. He said: `Ali b. Musa b. Ja`far b. Abi Ja`far al-Kamandani narrated to us from Ahmad b. Muhammad b. `Isa from Muhammad b. Abi `Umayr from al-Husayn b. Mus`ib al-Hamadani. He said: I heard al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad (as) say:
Fulfill trusts, even to a killer of al-Husayn b. `Ali (as).
